scope: classical continuum bundle, connection, curvature, Hodge, and Yang-Mills dictionary

base_geometry.four_dimensional_yang_mills_background: oriented Riemannian 4-manifold when Hodge/self-duality formulas are invoked

differential_forms.k_form_type: Omega^k(M,W) when W is the relevant coefficient bundle
differential_forms.two_form: alternating bilinear form on pairs of tangent vectors

covariant_derivative.leibniz: nabla_A(f s)=d f tensor s+f nabla_A s

su3_lie_algebra_bridge.local_connection_expansion: A=i A_mu^a T^a dx^mu for real coefficients in the fundamental representation

riemannian_hodge.hodge_source: Riemannian metric plus orientation on M
riemannian_hodge.hodge_type: *:Omega^k(M,W)->Omega^(4-k)(M,W) in the four-dimensional Euclidean test convention
riemannian_hodge.fiber_inner_product: Ad-invariant positive-definite Lie-algebra inner product chosen independently of the base metric

four_dimensional_reference_fixture.space: oriented Euclidean R^4 with orthonormal coframe (e0,e1,e2,e3)
four_dimensional_reference_fixture.orientation: e0 wedge e1 wedge e2 wedge e3 positive
four_dimensional_reference_fixture.purpose: finite-dimensional sign/convention regression only; not a continuum solver

flatness_and_parallel_transport.local_flatness_rule: on sufficiently small simply connected trivializing neighborhoods a flat connection is locally pure gauge
flatness_and_parallel_transport.forward_transport: P_gamma maps associated-fiber coordinates from gamma(0) to gamma(1)
flatness_and_parallel_transport.multi_chart_rule: subdivide path into trivializing charts and insert transition-function coordinate changes at chart boundaries

levi_civita_firewall.connection: nabla^LC on TM is the unique torsion-free metric-compatible connection determined by the base Riemannian metric

yang_mills_functional.background: oriented Riemannian 4-manifold with Ad-invariant Lie-algebra inner product

self_duality.decomposition: F_A=F_A^+ + F_A^- with F_A^+=(F_A+*F_A)/2 and F_A^-=(F_A-*F_A)/2
self_duality.bianchi_implication: in 4D, F_A=+/-*F_A together with D_A F_A=0 implies D_A^*F_A=0

lattice_continuum_dictionary.link: U_mu(x) approximates the Phase1D start-left transporter U_gamma along one oriented lattice edge; forward transport is its inverse
lattice_continuum_dictionary.plaquette: oriented plaquette product is a finite small-loop holonomy whose smooth small-spacing expansion contains F_mu_nu
lattice_continuum_dictionary.wilson_loop: normalized trace of discrete closed holonomy approximates the corresponding continuum holonomy observable under an appropriate continuum limit
lattice_continuum_dictionary.wilson_action: finite-spacing Wilson action is a lattice discretization; equality with the continuum Yang-Mills functional at nonzero lattice spacing is not claimed

claim_scope: classical differential-geometric definitions and finite-dimensional convention regressions only
